---
title: Error codes
description: Every stable error code, its meaning and what to do.
weight: 90
---

<!-- Generated by site/tools/errorcodes from internal/errcode/codes.go. Do not edit by hand. -->

Every error that reaches a user, a log reader or the API carries one of these codes. Codes never change meaning once released. The same code appears in the `error.code` field of API responses and in the output of the `nux` and `nuxd` commands.

| Code | Title | Message | Hint |
|---|---|---|---|
| `AGT-COL-001` | Container inventory unavailable | The agent cannot read containers through nux-sockguard. | Check that nux-sockguard is running, that Docker or Podman is running, and that the agent's user is in the nux group. |
| `AGT-COL-002` | Host facts incomplete | The agent could not read some host facts from /proc, /sys or /etc. | Check that the agent's sandbox allows reading them; other facts are still reported. |
| `AGT-COL-003` | Host metrics unavailable | The agent could not read host metrics from /proc or statfs. | Check that the agent's sandbox allows reading /proc and the mounted file systems; other metrics are still reported. |
| `AGT-COL-004` | Container metrics unavailable | The agent could not read container metrics from cgroups or through nux-sockguard. | Check that cgroups v2 is mounted at /sys/fs/cgroup and that nux-sockguard is running; other metrics are still reported. |
| `AGT-ENR-001` | Agent already enrolled | This host already holds an agent identity. | Run nux agent run, or pass --force to enrol again with a new token. |
| `AGT-ENR-002` | Enrolment failed | nuxd did not accept the enrolment request. | Create a new token in the UI and run nux agent enroll again. |
| `AGT-ENR-003` | Gateway not trusted | The server's certificate does not chain to the CA fingerprint in the token. | Check that the token was copied completely and that nothing intercepts the connection to the gateway. |
| `AGT-ID-001` | Agent identity unusable | The agent's key, certificate or identity file is missing or damaged. | Run nux agent enroll with a new token. |
| `AGT-ID-002` | Agent certificate expired | The agent was offline longer than its certificate lives and cannot renew it. | Run nux agent enroll --force with a new token. |
| `AGT-REV-001` | Agent revoked | nuxd no longer accepts this agent's certificate; it was revoked or removed. | Run nux agent enroll --force with a new token to bring the host back. |
| `ALR-RULE-001` | Alert already resolved | The alert is resolved, so it can no longer be acknowledged. | Reload the alert list; a new alert opens if the condition returns. |
| `ALR-SEND-001` | Notification rejected | The receiving service refused the notification (a client error such as a bad webhook URL or token). | Check the channel settings, then use the test button. |
| `ALR-SEND-002` | Notification not delivered | The receiving service did not answer, timed out or returned a server error, even after retries. | Check that the service is reachable; Nux Deck retries on the next alert. |
| `ALR-SEND-003` | Notification destination blocked | The channel points at an address that notifications may not reach (loopback, link-local, cloud metadata or, unless allowed, a private range). | Use a public address, or have an admin set allow_private on the channel for an internal target. |
| `ALR-SEND-004` | Channel paused after failures | Several deliveries to this channel failed in a row, so sending is paused for a short time. | Fix the channel, then wait a minute or use the test button. |
| `ALR-SEND-005` | Mail transport refused | The mail server could not be reached securely: STARTTLS or TLS failed, or authentication was refused without encryption. | Use security starttls or tls, and check the mail server's certificate and credentials. |
| `ALR-SEND-006` | Test sent too often | A test message was sent to this channel too recently. | Wait a few seconds and try again. |
| `ALR-SEND-007` | Notification queue full | Too many notifications were waiting, so this one was dropped. | Check slow or failing channels; alerts are still recorded. |
| `ALR-SEND-008` | Channel disabled | The channel is disabled, so nothing was sent. | Enable the channel. |
| `API-INT-001` | Internal error | Something went wrong on the server. | Try again; if it keeps happening, report the request ID from the X-Request-ID response header. |
| `API-LIM-001` | Too many live connections | The server is serving as many live update streams as it allows. | Close other tabs or try again in a moment. |
| `API-NF-001` | Resource not found | No such endpoint or resource. | Check the URL against the API documentation. |
| `API-PRE-001` | Item changed | Someone else changed this item after you loaded it. | Reload the item and apply your change again. |
| `API-PRE-002` | Version required | This change needs the If-Match header with the ETag of the version you edited. | Send the ETag from the last GET of the item in If-Match. |
| `API-VAL-001` | Invalid request | The request body is missing, malformed or contains unknown fields. | Send a JSON body with Content-Type: application/json and only the documented fields. |
| `AUD-CHAIN-001` | Audit chain broken | The hash chain of the audit log does not verify: an entry was modified, removed or inserted outside nuxd. | Restore the database from a backup taken before the first broken entry and investigate who had write access to it. |
| `AUD-EXP-001` | Audit export failed | The audit export could not be completed. | Try again; if it keeps happening, report the request ID from the X-Request-ID response header. |
| `AUTH-DENY-001` | Sign-in failed | The email or password is incorrect. | Check the email and password and try again. |
| `AUTH-DENY-002` | Too many attempts | Too many failed attempts from this address. | Wait a few minutes and try again. |
| `AUTH-DENY-003` | Sign-in required | You must be signed in to do this. | Sign in and try again. |
| `AUTH-DENY-004` | Request blocked | The request failed the cross-site request check. | Reload the page and try again. |
| `AUTH-DENY-005` | Permission denied | Your role does not allow this action. | Ask an administrator for the required role. |
| `AUTH-LOCK-001` | Account temporarily locked | Too many failed attempts for this account from this address. | Wait 15 minutes and try again. |
| `AUTH-OIDC-001` | Single sign-on not set up | No identity provider is configured for single sign-on. | Ask an administrator to configure single sign-on in Settings, or sign in with your password. |
| `AUTH-OIDC-002` | Sign-in attempt expired | The sign-in attempt timed out or did not start in this browser. | Start the sign-in again from the sign-in page. |
| `AUTH-OIDC-003` | Identity provider did not complete sign-in | The identity provider refused the sign-in or could not be reached. | Try again. If it keeps failing, ask an administrator to check the single sign-on settings. |
| `AUTH-OIDC-004` | Identity token not accepted | The identity provider token failed a check on its signature, algorithm, issuer, audience, expiry or nonce. | Ask an administrator to check the client ID, the issuer and the signing algorithm of the provider. |
| `AUTH-OIDC-005` | Email not verified | The identity provider did not confirm this email address, or sent none. | Verify your email address with the identity provider, then sign in again. |
| `AUTH-OIDC-006` | Email domain not allowed | Single sign-on is limited to certain email domains, and yours is not one of them. | Ask an administrator to allow your domain. |
| `AUTH-OIDC-007` | No account for this sign-in | No account matches this identity, and accounts are not created on sign-in. | Ask an administrator to create your account or to allow automatic accounts. |
| `AUTH-OIDC-008` | No role for this sign-in | None of your identity provider groups has a role on this server. | Ask an administrator to bind one of your groups to a role. |
| `AUTH-OIDC-009` | Account disabled | This account is disabled. | Ask an administrator to enable it. |
| `AUTH-OIDC-010` | Account already linked | The email address or identity already belongs to another account. | Ask an administrator to check the accounts. |
| `AUTH-OIDC-011` | Public URL missing | Single sign-on needs the public URL of this server for its redirect address. | Set server.public_url (NUXD_PUBLIC_URL) to the https address users open, then restart nuxd. |
| `AUTH-PWD-001` | Password not accepted | The password does not meet the password policy. | Use at least 12 characters and avoid common or breached passwords. |
| `AUTH-RBAC-001` | Action not permitted | The action is not known to the permission policy, so it is denied. | Report the request ID from the X-Request-ID response header. |
| `AUTH-RBAC-002` | Outside your scope | Your role is limited to certain environments or tags and does not cover this item. | Ask an administrator to widen the scope of your role. |
| `AUTH-RBAC-003` | Role binding not accepted | The role binding has an unknown role or subject, or an invalid scope. | Use the role admin, operator or viewer, a user ID or group name, and a scope of environments and tag sets. |
| `AUTH-RBAC-004` | Role binding not found | No such role binding. | Reload the list of role bindings. |
| `AUTH-SETUP-001` | Setup token not accepted | The setup token is missing or wrong. | Run nuxd setup-token on the server and paste its output. |
| `AUTH-SETUP-002` | Setup already completed | This server already has an administrator. | Sign in instead. |
| `AUTH-TOKEN-001` | API token not accepted | The API token is unknown, expired or revoked. | Create a new token in your account settings. |
| `AUTH-TOKEN-002` | Token scope too wide | A token can only grant roles and scopes its owner holds. | Choose a role and scope no wider than your own. |
| `AUTH-TOKEN-003` | API token not found | No such token for your account. | Reload the list and try again. |
| `AUTH-TOTP-001` | Verification code not accepted | The code is wrong, expired or was already used. | Enter the current 6-digit code from your authenticator app, or a recovery code. |
| `AUTH-TOTP-002` | Sign-in step expired | The second sign-in step timed out or was used too often. | Sign in again with your password. |
| `AUTH-TOTP-003` | Two-factor state does not allow this | Two-factor authentication is already on, or was not started. | Start the enrolment again, or sign in with your authenticator. |
| `AUTH-USER-001` | Email already in use | An account with this email address already exists. | Use a different email address. |
| `AUTH-USER-002` | Last administrator | This would leave the server without an enabled administrator. | Make another user an administrator first. |
| `AUTH-USER-003` | User not found | No such user. | Reload the list and try again. |
| `BAK-AUDIT-001` | Restored audit log is broken | The archive's audit hash chain does not verify, so the restore was refused and the current data directory was left as it was. | Use an archive taken before the broken entry, and investigate who could write to the database. |
| `BAK-AUTH-001` | Backup passphrase rejected | The passphrase is wrong, or the archive was altered after it was written. | Check the passphrase file. If it is correct, the archive is damaged: use another copy. |
| `BAK-FMT-001` | Backup archive unreadable | The file is not a Nux Deck backup or its contents are corrupt. | Use an archive written by nuxd backup, and copy it again if the transfer may have failed. |
| `BAK-HASH-001` | Backup checksum mismatch | A file in the archive does not match its recorded checksum, or the file list does not match. | Use another copy of the archive; nothing was restored. |
| `BAK-LIMIT-001` | Backup exceeds size limits | The archive declares more data than the restore limits allow. | Check the archive is not a decompression bomb; raise the limits only for a trusted archive. |
| `BAK-LOCK-001` | Data directory in use | nuxd is running against this data directory, so it cannot be backed up or restored now. | Stop nuxd (systemctl stop nuxd), run the command, then start nuxd again. |
| `BAK-PASS-001` | Backup passphrase missing | The archive or command needs a passphrase, and none was given or the passphrase file is empty. | Pass --passphrase-file with the passphrase used to create the archive, or pass --unencrypted when creating one without a passphrase. |
| `BAK-PATH-001` | Unsafe backup entry | The archive holds an entry with an absolute, parent or linked path, or a special file. | Do not restore this archive; it was not written by nuxd backup. |
| `BAK-REST-001` | Restore not completed | The restore could not replace the data directory. The previous state was put back or left in place. | Read the message, fix the cause (for example an existing .pre-restore directory), and run restore again. |
| `BAK-SRC-001` | Data directory has unsupported entries | The data directory holds a symbolic link or special file that a backup will not copy. | Replace the link with the file it points to, or remove the special file, then back up again. |
| `BAK-TRUNC-001` | Backup archive truncated | The archive ends before its last section, so it is incomplete. | Copy the archive again; nothing was restored. |
| `BAK-UPG-001` | Pre-upgrade backup failed | A backup could not be written before database migrations, so the migrations were not applied and nuxd did not start. | Check free disk space and the backups directory permissions, then start nuxd again. |
| `BAK-VER-001` | Backup from a newer version | The archive was written by a newer nuxd than this one and cannot be restored safely. | Install the nuxd version that wrote the archive, or a newer one, and restore with it. |
| `CHK-DNS-001` | DNS lookup failed | The name did not resolve, or the resolver did not answer. | Check the name, the record type and the resolver. |
| `CHK-DNS-002` | Unexpected DNS answer | The answer did not contain all the expected values. | Check the record, or update the expected values. |
| `CHK-HTTP-001` | HTTP request failed | The HTTP(S) request failed or timed out before a response arrived. | Check the URL, that the service listens, and the timeout. |
| `CHK-HTTP-002` | Unexpected HTTP status | The response status was not one of the expected codes. | Check the service, or adjust the expected status codes. |
| `CHK-HTTP-003` | Keyword not found | The response body did not contain the expected keyword within the size limit. | Check the keyword, or that it appears early in the response. |
| `CHK-HTTP-004` | JSON match failed | The JSON response did not satisfy the path condition, or was not valid JSON. | Check the path and expected value against the real response. |
| `CHK-HTTP-005` | Too many redirects | The request was redirected more often than the check allows. | Point the check at the final URL, or raise the redirect limit. |
| `CHK-NET-001` | Target address blocked | The target resolves to an address that checks run by the server may not reach. | Use a public address, or run the check from an agent inside that network. Operators may allow private ranges per check. |
| `CHK-PING-001` | No ping reply | The host did not answer any ICMP echo request in time. | Check that the host is up and allows ICMP. |
| `CHK-PING-002` | ICMP not permitted | This machine may not send unprivileged ICMP echo requests. | Allow the runner's group in net.ipv4.ping_group_range, or run the check from another agent. |
| `CHK-RUN-001` | Runner offline | The agent that runs this check is not connected, so the check could not run. | Wait for the agent to reconnect. |
| `CHK-RUN-002` | Runner busy | The agent could not take the check right now. | The next scheduled run will try again. |
| `CHK-RUN-003` | Runner did not answer | The agent did not send a result in time. | Check the agent's connection and load. |
| `CHK-RUN-004` | Run requested too often | This check was run on demand too recently. | Wait a few seconds and try again. |
| `CHK-SEC-001` | Check credentials unavailable | A stored credential of this check could not be read. | Save the check again with its credentials. |
| `CHK-TCP-001` | TCP connection failed | The TCP connection was refused, unreachable or timed out. | Check the host, the port and any firewall between the runner and the target. |
| `CHK-TLS-001` | TLS handshake failed | The TLS handshake did not complete. | Check that the port speaks TLS and the server name matches. |
| `CHK-TLS-002` | Certificate not trusted | The certificate chain or name did not verify. | Fix the certificate, or turn chain verification off for this check. |
| `CHK-TLS-003` | Certificate expires soon | The certificate has expired or expires within the warning period. | Renew the certificate. |
| `CLI-ARG-001` | Unknown or missing command | The command is missing or not recognised. | Run nux without arguments to list the commands. |
| `CLI-ARG-002` | Invalid command-line argument | A flag or argument is not valid. | Check the usage text for the command. |
| `CLI-ARG-003` | Command not implemented yet | This command is a placeholder in this version. | Update nux, or see the roadmap for when it arrives. |
| `CLI-ARG-004` | Ambiguous target | More than one host, container or check matches the name you gave. | Use the ID shown by the list command instead of the name. |
| `CLI-AUTH-001` | Not signed in | No API token is available for nux. | Run nux login --server URL --token-file FILE, or set NUX_TOKEN. |
| `CLI-CFG-001` | Config file unavailable | The nux config file could not be read or written. | Check that the file and its directory are readable and writable by your user. |
| `CLI-LOG-001` | Log stream stopped | The log stream was refused or kept failing, so nux gave up. | Check the target name, your access to it, and that the host is online. |
| `CLI-NET-001` | Server unreachable | nux could not complete the request to nuxd. | Check the server URL and that nuxd is running, then try again. |
| `CLI-NET-002` | Server certificate not trusted | The server certificate is not signed by a trusted authority, or does not match the pinned fingerprint. | Use --ca-file for a private CA, or --pin with the fingerprint shown by nuxd. Re-run login if the certificate was replaced on purpose. |
| `CLI-NUXD-001` | nuxd not found | nux backup and nux restore run the nuxd binary, which holds the server data and master key, and it is not on PATH. | Run them on the server host, or set NUX_NUXD_BIN to the nuxd binary's path. |
| `GW-AUTH-001` | Agent certificate not accepted | The agent certificate is unknown, revoked or does not identify an agent. | Enrol the host again with a new token. |
| `GW-CA-001` | Agent CA unavailable | The internal certificate authority could not be loaded or created. | Check that the pki directory in the data directory is readable by nuxd and that ca.crt and ca.key belong together. |
| `GW-CSR-001` | Certificate request rejected | The certificate signing request is malformed or uses an unsupported key. | Update the agent, which generates an ECDSA P-256 key and signs the request itself. |
| `GW-RATE-001` | Too many enrolment attempts | Too many failed enrolment attempts from this address. | Wait a few minutes and try again with a valid token. |
| `GW-STR-001` | Agent stream protocol error | The first message on an agent stream must be Hello, sent promptly. | Update the agent to a version that speaks protocol v1. |
| `GW-STR-002` | Agent message too large | An agent message exceeded the 4 MB limit. | Update the agent; metric batches are split to stay under 1 MB. |
| `GW-STR-003` | Replaced by a newer connection | The same agent connected again, so the older stream was closed. | Make sure only one agent runs per host. |
| `GW-STR-004` | Agent heartbeats missed | No heartbeat arrived for three intervals, so the stream was closed. | Check the network path between the agent and nuxd. |
| `GW-TOK-001` | Enrolment token not accepted | The enrolment token is unknown, expired or already used. | Create a new token in the UI; each token works once and expires after 1 hour. |
| `LOG-SRC-001` | Log source unavailable | The agent cannot read this container's logs through nux-sockguard. | Check that the container exists, that nux-sockguard is running and that Docker or Podman is running. |
| `LOG-SRC-002` | Journal unavailable | The agent cannot read the systemd journal for this unit. | Check that journalctl is installed on the host and that the agent's user may read the journal (systemd-journal group). |
| `LOG-SRC-003` | Host not connected | The agent of this host is offline, so there is nothing to stream. | Wait for the host to come back online. |
| `LOG-STR-001` | Too many live log streams | The limit on concurrent live log streams was reached. | Close other log tabs or try again in a moment. |
| `LOG-STR-002` | Invalid log stream request | The log stream request was malformed or duplicated. | Reload the page and open the log again. |
| `LOG-STR-003` | Log stream lagging | Your connection could not keep up, so some log lines were dropped. | Narrow the stream with a filter or watch a quieter source. |
| `SKG-DENY-001` | Request refused by nux-sockguard | nux-sockguard forwards only a fixed list of read-only container API calls, and this was not one of them. | Nothing to fix on the host; the agent never asks for anything outside the list. |
| `SKG-SOCK-001` | Socket cannot be set up | nux-sockguard could not create its listening socket. | Check that the directory exists and belongs to nux-sg, and that the path is not a regular file. |
| `SKG-UPS-001` | Container runtime unreachable | nux-sockguard could not get an answer from the Docker or Podman socket. | Check that Docker or Podman is running and that nux-sg can read its socket (docker group, or --upstream). |
| `SKG-UPS-002` | Container runtime response rejected | The runtime's answer was too large or not in the expected shape, so it was not forwarded. | Report the code and the runtime version; the response was dropped rather than passed on unfiltered. |
| `SRV-CFG-001` | Configuration file unreadable | The configuration file could not be read or parsed. | Check the file path, permissions and YAML syntax, and remove unknown keys. |
| `SRV-CFG-002` | Invalid configuration value | A configuration value is missing or not valid. | Fix the named setting in the file or in its NUXD_* environment variable. |
| `SRV-IO-001` | Data directory unusable | The data directory could not be created or opened. | Check that the path exists or can be created and that nuxd's user can write to it. |
| `SRV-IO-002` | TLS certificate unavailable | The TLS certificate could not be loaded or generated. | Check the certificate and key files, or remove them to let nuxd generate a self-signed pair. |
| `SRV-IO-003` | Cannot listen on address | nuxd could not bind a network address. | Check that the port is free and that the address in the configuration is correct. |
| `SRV-MIG-001` | Database migration failed | A database migration could not be applied. | Restore the database from a backup and report the error code. |
| `SRV-MIG-002` | Database is newer than this nuxd | The database was written by a newer nuxd version; downgrades are blocked. | Run the newer nuxd version, or restore a backup taken before the upgrade. |
| `SRV-MIG-003` | Applied migration was modified | A migration recorded in the database no longer matches this build. | Never edit an applied migration. Use the release the database was created with. |
| `SRV-SEC-001` | Master key unusable | The master encryption key is missing, malformed, or its file is readable by other users. | Provide 32 random bytes, base64-encoded, in NUXD_MASTER_KEY or in the file named by secrets.master_key_file (mode 0600), or remove both so nuxd creates data_dir/master.key. |
| `SRV-SEC-002` | Secret cannot be decrypted | A stored secret failed authentication: it was altered, moved, or sealed under a different master key. | Start nuxd with the master key the database was created with, or restore the database and key from the same backup. |
| `STP-RATE-001` | Too many status page requests | This address asked for status pages too often. | Wait a minute and try again. |
| `STP-SLUG-001` | Status page address taken | Another status page already uses this slug. | Choose a different slug. |
| `TEL-SEND-001` | Telemetry report not delivered | The daily telemetry report could not reach the endpoint and was dropped. | Nothing to fix; the next report is tried tomorrow. Turn telemetry off in Settings if this host should not reach the internet. |
| `TEL-SEND-002` | Telemetry endpoint refused the report | The telemetry endpoint answered with an error status and the report was dropped. | Nothing to fix; the next report is tried tomorrow. |
